svg.title: What the product does

text.tspan: It screws onto a 28 mm PET bottle (or a tap) and filters microplastics as you squeeze. The removable steel disc is also the sample: lift it out and look
at what it caught under a phone microscope.
Screw onto any 500 mL or 1 L PET bottle (28 mm PCO 1881 neck). A
tap adapter lets tap pressure do the work:
with the pauses to let go. On release, an
umbrella valve lets air back in.
Lift the disc into the holder. Nile red stain + blue LED + a 140× clip-on
Backflush with tap water through the spout: the cake comes off and
Ø52 × 50 mm outside the bottle, +12.5 mm inside
316L body, sintered 316L filters, FDA silicone seals.
No plastic in the water path
20 µm laminate cup, 17.2 cm², built in
Ø40 cassette, 11.6 cm² active: A 1 µm (default), B
0.26 L/min squeezed at 60 N; 2.2 L/min on a 1.5 bar
99.5 % of 1–100 µm particles by count; 99 % at
